[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Liquidity: Solution - Partner with centralized exchanges or participate in liquidity mining programs to increase liquidity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. User Experience: Solution - Focus on improving the user experience through intuitive design, user-friendly interfaces, and better onboarding processes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Infrastructure: Solution - Invest in infrastructure development and improve network speeds to provide a better user experience.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant concludes that Web3 startups should focus on building a strong community, improving the user experience, and developing the infrastructure needed to support decentralized applications.
